vision.name: Orange Retribution Mastery
vision.text:
(At the start of your opponent's first turn, search your Life Deck for a Styled non-[Continuous] Drill and place it into play.)
[Continuous]: Whenever your MP changes levels, you may shuffle all Drills you control into their owner's Life Deck.
POWER: The next Styled attack you perform this combat has its power stage cost reduced to 0. Raise your anger up to 2 levels. If your MP has changed levels this combat, search your Life Deck for a Styled Drill and place it into play.
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; title strip partly hidden on the sheet, name from filename
